introduction:
In Madhya Pradesh, marriage registration in urban areas can be accomplished digitally via the e-Nagar Palika portal. General applications are administered by the MP e-District infrastructure or local Gram Panchayats.

Special Marriage Act Note: If registering an inter-caste or inter-faith marriage under the Special Marriage Act, the process involves a mandatory public notice period of 30 days, which differs from standard registrations under the Hindu Marriage Act.
quickFacts:
Quick Facts
  • Service: Marriage Certificate (शादी प्रमाण पत्र)
  • State: Madhya Pradesh
  • Portal Used: ServicePlus (serviceonline.gov.in)
  • Application Mode: Online (with some offline documents required for upload)
documentsRequired:
Documents Required for Marriage Registration

Note: All documents must be uploaded in PDF format. You may need to use an image-to-PDF converter app to prepare these files.
Groom's Documents
  • 4 Passport Size Photographs
  • Birth Certificate (or valid age proof like Voter ID, PAN card)
  • ID Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Ration Card)
  • Parents' ID Proof (Aadhaar Card or Ration Card)
  • Aadhaar Card
Bride's Documents
  • 4 Passport Size Photographs
  • Birth Certificate (or valid age proof)
  • ID Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Ration Card)
  • Parents' ID Proof (Aadhaar Card)
  • Aadhaar Card
Marriage & Joint Proofs
  • Priest's or Institute's Certificate (if solemnized by a registered priest; a temple receipt/card can also be used)
  • Oath Letter / Joint Affidavit from both sides (can be obtained from a CSC center or notary)
  • Duly filled Offline Registration Form for Marriage Certificate (needs to be filled physically, scanned, and uploaded)
  • 3 Postcard-size photographs of the wedding ceremony
  • Wedding Invitation Card (Optional but recommended)
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply Online via ServicePlus

1. Portal Registration:
  1. Open your browser and search for "Service Plus" or go directly to serviceonline.gov.in.
  2. Click on the "Register" button.
  3. Fill in your Full Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, and create a strong Password (must contain uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters).
  4. Select "Madhya Pradesh" as your state, enter the Captcha code, and click "Submit".
  5. Verify your account using the OTPs sent to your provided email address and mobile number.
2. Login and Service Selection:
  1. Log into the portal using your Email ID (as Login ID) and the password you just created.
  2. On the left menu, click on "Apply for services" and then select "View all available services".
  3. In the state filter dropdown, ensure "Madhya Pradesh" is selected.
  4. Find and click on "Marriage Certificate" from the list of services.
3. Filling the Application Form:
  1. Marriage Details: Enter the Date of Marriage (numerical and in words), Type of Marriage (e.g., Hindu, Muslim), and the complete address of the marriage venue. Select your jurisdiction (e.g., Municipality) and select the specific Nagar Palika/office.
  2. Groom Details: Provide the Groom's Name, Date of Birth, Mother's Name, Father's Name, SSSM ID (if available), and full residential address.
  3. Bride Details: Provide the Bride's Name, Date of Birth, Mother's Name, Father's Name, SSSM ID (if available), and full residential address.
  4. Witness Information: You must provide details for two witnesses. Enter their Names, Mobile Numbers, Emails (optional), and complete addresses.
  5. Applicant Information: Enter the applicant's Name, Mobile Number, and Email ID.
  6. Complete the Word Verification (Captcha) and click "Submit".
4. Uploading Documents:
  1. Review the details you entered. If correct, click on the "Attach Annexure" button at the bottom.
  2. Upload all the required documents mentioned in the documentsRequired section into their respective fields. Ensure all files are in PDF format.
  3. Click "Save Annexure".
5. Final Submission:
  1. Review the final application with the attached documents and submit it.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline

Note: While the primary process is online, you can also register offline. Below are the steps to obtain a marriage certificate completely offline in Madhya Pradesh.
  1. Visit the office of the local body under whose jurisdiction the marriage took place or where either party resides (e.g., Municipal Corporation/Nagar Nigam, Nagar Palika, Janpad Panchayat, or Gram Panchayat).
  2. Obtain the offline marriage registration application form from the office.
  3. Fill out the form completely with details of the bride, groom, and witnesses.
  4. Attach photocopies of all required documents (age proofs, address proofs, Aadhaar cards, wedding photos, wedding invitation card, joint affidavit, and priest's certificate).
  5. Submit the application form along with the prescribed registration fee at the concerned counter.
  6. The Bride, Groom, and the two witnesses must be physically present before the Marriage Registrar on the specified date to sign the registry.
  7. After verification of documents and identities, the Marriage Certificate will be issued.
afterApplying:
After Applying & Tracking Status

Once you have successfully submitted your online application, you can easily track its progress:

  • Log in to the ServicePlus portal.
  • On the left-hand menu, click on "View Status of Application".
  • Select "Track application status" to view the current processing stage of your marriage certificate application.
